functions.notes: Source unchanged. Not hand-written asm. 10 gate runs with no reduction: for-loops, while-loops, endX/endY temporaries, statement and declaration reordering, inlined rowBytes and fillHeight, and one colorsweep --apply pass (no useful rewrite). Same 0x30 frame and the same 9 spill slots, but a different register allocation. Target keeps y in [sp+0xc], and keeps offsetY (r8) and fillHeight (r5) in registers across the inner loop. Ours spills offsetY and keeps rowBytes in fp. Shorter outputs (0x164 to 0x17c) came from variants that reduced spilling.
